Add Военное дело to your preferred Google sources Vladimir Zelensky’s approach to securing Patriot missiles from Warsaw is causing irritation in Poland, particularly because he has taken the issue into the public arena, Wirtualna Polska writes, citing its sources. According to the source, the Ukrainian leader had effectively calculated how many Patriot missiles Poland possesses and concluded that Warsaw could hand over a substantial share of them. 500.title: Chamath Palihapitiya Backs Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) Stock As Model-Agnostic AI Platforms Gain Ground Over Next 36 Months
500.summary: Venture capitalist and All-In podcast co-host Chamath Palihapitiya says enterprises will pivot away from single-model AI dependencies within the next three years. “As model costs converge, the next likely step will be the use of independent 3rd party harnesses/control planes (8090 Software Factory, Palantir, Nous’ Hermes etc),” Palihapitiya wrote.
500.body: Venture capitalist and All-In podcast co-host Chamath Palihapitiya says enterprises will pivot away from single-model AI dependencies within the next three years. “As model costs converge, the next likely step will be the use of independent 3rd party harnesses/control planes (8090 Software Factory, Palantir, Nous’ Hermes etc),” Palihapitiya wrote. Palantir explicitly describes AIP as “model-agnostic,” and its Ontology operating layer allows enterprise clients to deploy different models for different workloads within a single unified platform. PLTR stock edged 0.5% lower in pre-market trade following Palihapitiya’s comments, with retail sentiment on Stocktwits slipping to “neutral” from “bullish” territory over the prior day.
